Specification: This module specifies a randomized version of the spanning tree construction algorithm. Instead of taking the set of edges as a constant, it defines Edges as a randomly chosen set of edges connecting the nodes in Nodes, using TLC's RandomElement operator to select random subsets for each node. The algorithm models the process of assigning parent (mom) and distance (dist) values to each node, starting from a designated Root, and updating these values according to the distances of neighboring nodes. The specification includes type correctness, initialization, and a Next action that updates the state, as well as temporal properties for safety (ensuring the postcondition holds when no further steps are enabled) and liveness (eventually reaching the postcondition). The model is intended for use with TLC to check correctness on randomly generated graphs, facilitating testing across different topologies.
